# MANIFEST — the two numbers the emptied-place report is about.
#
# This file holds THREE top-level blocks of its own: the heading below, the
# include shortcode, and the container that holds nothing but a marker. The
# marker's container is the third of them.
#
#   author position: 3
#
# Quarto expands the include before any filter runs, replacing the one
# shortcode block with the part file's three, so the filter is handed a
# document whose blocks are shifted two places down from where they were
# written. The report names the position in THAT document.
#
#   reported position: 5
#
# The two numbers differ, which is the whole point of this fixture: a report
# that called its number the author's own block position would be wrong here.
